data.name: Choose a pay schedule and tell FullWorth how many paychecks ahead to plan for each bill. Recommendations are guidance only; FullWorth does not move or reserve money.
data.value: Elige un calendario de pago e indica a FullWorth cuántos sueldos antes debe planificar cada factura. Las recomendaciones son solo orientativas; FullWorth no mueve ni reserva dinero.
